concern_text: Median first response to online enquiries has slipped past one hour for two periods.
Booked test drives are being attended less often than in the prior period.
Scheduled ageing reviews are being missed on part of the stock.
Listings are publishing without the required photo set for three periods.
Enquiry response, test drive attendance, and listing quality all declined this period.
Advertised prices are not being refreshed on the agreed cadence.
